base_url.description: The base url of the axiom api.

dashboard.description: The dashboard document as a JSON string (for example from `jsonencode(...)`).

overwrite.description: When `true`, force update and ignore `version` conflicts.

uid.description: Stable dashboard identifier. If omitted, Axiom generates one.

edge_deployment.description: Edge deployment for the dataset (for example, 'cloud.eu-central-1.aws')

kind.description: Dataset kind. Must be one of: 'axiom:events:v1', 'otel:metrics:v1', 'otel:traces:v1', 'otel:logs:v1'. Defaults to 'axiom:events:v1'

alert_on_no_data.description: If the monitor should trigger an alert if there is no data

apl_query.description: The APL query used inside the monitor (mutually exclusive with mpl_query)

compare_days.description: The number of days to compare for anomaly detection

created_at.description: The timestamp when the monitor was created

created_by.description: The ID of the user who created the monitor

delay.description: The delay in seconds before the monitor runs (useful for situations where data is batched/delayed)

disabled_until.description: The time the monitor will be disabled until

interval_minutes.description: How often the monitor should run

mpl_query.description: The MPL query used inside the monitor (mutually exclusive with apl_query)

notifier_ids.description: A list of notifier id's to be used when this monitor triggers

notify_by_group.description: If the monitor should track non-time groups separately

notify_every_run.description: Indicates whether to send notifications on every trigger

operator.description: Operator used in monitor trigger evaluation

resolvable.description: Determines whether the events triggered by the monitor are individually resolvable. This has no effect on threshold monitors

skip_resolved.description: Specifies whether to skip resolved alerts

threshold.description: The threshold where the monitor should trigger

tolerance.description: The tolerance percentage for anomaly detection

trigger_after_n_positive_results.description: The number of positive results needed before triggering

trigger_from_n_runs.description: The number of consecutive check runs that must trigger before triggering an alert

type.description: The type of the monitor. Possible values include: 'Threshold', 'AnomalyDetection', 'MatchEvent'

headers.description: Any headers associated with the request

data.description: Ability to manage the data in a dataset

ingest.description: Ability to ingest into the specified dataset

query.description: Ability to query the specified dataset

starred_queries.description: Ability to perform actions on starred queries for the specified dataset

trim.description: Ability to trim the data in a dataset

vacuum.description: Ability to vacuum the fields in a dataset

virtual_fields.description: Ability to perform actions on virtual fields for the provided dataset

dataset_capabilities.description: The capabilities available to the token for each dataset

expires_at.description: The time when the token expires. If not set, the token will not expire. Must be in RFC3339 format

id.description: The unique identifier of the token to be used when interacting with the token

annotations.description: Ability to perform actions on annotations

audit_log.description: Ability to read the audit log

rbac.description: Ability to manage roles and groups

shared_access_keys.description: Ability to manage shared access keys

org_capabilities.description: The organisation capabilities available to the token

rotation_grace_period.description: How long the previous token remains valid when this token is regenerated during an update (for example: 30s, 5m, 1h). Defaults to 48h when omitted.

token.description: The token value to be used in API calls

dataset.description: Dataset the virtual field belongs to

description.description: Optional description of the virtual field

expression.description: Expression defining the virtual field logic

created_at.description: Creation timestamp returned by the API.

id.description: Internal dashboard identifier returned by the API.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp returned by the API.

updated_by.description: Last updater returned by the API.
